result.clarifying_question: Which specific release does "the timed-out production release" refer to? Please provide the service name plus an identifying reference (release/version, pipeline run ID, or change ticket) and the approximate date/time, and note whether "timed-out" refers to the deployment run itself or an approval-gate timeout.
result.rationale: The request is a legitimate, researchable governance question (whether a production release carried service-owner approval), so abstention is not warranted. However, 'the timed-out production release' has no resolvable referent: no service, release identifier, run or change-ticket ID, or time window is supplied, and no sources are available to disambiguate it. Release identity is decision-changing — the approval answer is entirely specific to the release in question, and guessing the referent risks researching the wrong deployment and returning a wrong or misleading authorization determination. The dual meaning of 'timed-out' (deployment failure vs. approval-gate expiry) also changes which records must be searched. One blocking clarification is therefore required before a research-mission/1 boundary can be drawn without inventing scope, facts, or authority.
